title: Grade 12 CAT theory paper (CAPS-style, 50 marks)
task: Write an essay of 200-250 words on the topic: 'Technology has done more good than harm for young South Africans.' This is the Grade 12 CAT theory written response.

bands.text: Outstanding response to the topic. Ideas are intelligent, mature and fully developed with specific examples. Clear evidence of planning.
Very good response. Ideas are relevant and well developed, with some specific detail. Planning is evident.
Satisfactory response. Ideas are relevant but ordinary or only partly developed; examples are general.
Inconsistent response. Ideas are thin, repetitive or unclear; little development or planning.
Off topic, largely irrelevant, or far too short to assess. No evidence of planning.
Tone, register and vocabulary highly appropriate. Language is confident and virtually error-free.
Language is effective and largely correct; vocabulary is appropriate with minor errors.
Language is adequate; errors in grammar, spelling or punctuation do not impede meaning.
Limited vocabulary; frequent errors that sometimes impede meaning.
Language is seriously flawed; errors make the text hard to understand.
Clear introduction, logically ordered paragraphs with links between them, and a strong conclusion.
Logical paragraphs with an introduction and conclusion; some linking.
Paragraphing present but uneven; introduction or conclusion is weak.
Little paragraphing; ideas are loosely ordered.
